title: No invoice-line or scan part lookup offers an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOSCREEN-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NOSCREEN PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is invoiced and its line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL NOSCREEN line") sold another active part, {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOSCREEN-02).
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and its Finance tab.
  2. Look on the invoice for a way to add a part to an invoice line directly.
  3. Go back to the Lines tab, open the ⋮ menu on {Line-1} and click "Request part".
  4. Look in the "New Part Request" dialog for a barcode or scan button next to Part Number.
  5. Close the dialog with ×.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The invoice offers no part lookup of its own on its lines. If this build does offer one, type the start of {Part-A} in it: no row for {Part-A} is offered.
  • Step 4: There is no barcode or scan button. If this build has one, scanning or entering {Part-A} through it must not offer {Part-A}.
  • Steps 2 and 4: If either control exists, write its name in the result comment so the case can be extended.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R4, S9-R7, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows an invoice-line or scan lookup. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §10 Requirement Traceability. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R4: “If ShopView adds a part lookup to an invoice line outside a work order or part sale, that lookup does not return inactive parts.”
  • S9-R7: “If ShopView adds a barcode or scan part lookup, that lookup does not return inactive parts.”
  • PRD Story 9 context note: “S9-R4 and S9-R7 describe screens ShopView does not have. They are kept so that any future lookup of that kind follows the same rule.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §10 Requirement Traceability: “No such screen exists; the shared filter covers any future lookup”
